title: A repeatable cloud development environment
description: Installed locked Python and website dependencies, checked the real scanner and repair demo, validated website builds and pages, and added a child-process reaper for the container’s cancellation tests. This prepares development; it does not add an application feature.

title: A clearer guide and a visible development story
description: Organized the docs around setup, review, and repair; refreshed terminal captures with one Ghost theme; and added this dated phase timeline with an expandable record of every available commit. Development notes preserve the outcome of this conversation.

title: A calmer, more readable landing page
description: Refined the hero and section spacing, increased supporting text sizes, organized workflow and coverage into consistent cards, and moved installation to the final call to action. Compact expandable phases keep the complete dated commit record accessible on desktop, mobile, and without JavaScript.

title: A more helpful interactive workspace
description: Organized the REPL welcome screen, added a responsive command-description footer, and extended the picker to local command options, finite choices, workflow guides, and command help. Selections edit the input before a separate submission; shared execution guards and plain-terminal fallbacks remain in place. Updated the guide and workspace capture to show the current interface.

title: One Ghost identity, from terminal to website
description: Rebuilt the landing page around the product, its review workflow, and actual workspace, review, and repair output. Website colors now come directly from the terminal palette. Matching typography, documentation, and six refreshed captures give Ghost one consistent identity; responsive captures keep the product readable on mobile.

title: Current source checks and broader shell review coverage
description: Added ghost freshness to inspect saved source hashes, moved HEAD, and unreviewed supported paths without rescanning or changing evidence. Expanded Node shell-command detection across imports, aliases, synchronous APIs, and explicit shell options. On 179 independent fixtures, detection rose from 3 to 115 expected candidates, with no matches in 64 safe or unrelated cases. Linux regressions and the real review/repair journey passed. Static candidates remain suspected; the regression corpus becomes part of future improvement checks.

title: Browse changes while keeping the evidence visible
description: Added category, severity and confidence filters and paged comparisons, plus review history pages with full totals from one read-only snapshot. Repeated locations show saved source changes; both review contexts and baseline access counts remain visible even when comparison is blocked. Equal-level duplicate pairing avoids misleading severity changes when a duplicate disappears. Real stale-source, rescan and comparison captures extend the consistent terminal gallery. The next cycle prioritizes the observed storage-concurrency issue before adding reviewer decisions.

title: FalkorDB triage for Graph Hacks
description: Built a new optional graph triage command, synthetic dataset, parameterized loader, Cypher ranking and evidence-path agent for the Graph Hacks submission. The real FalkorDB demo prioritizes F-002 through its public-service and open-incident links; removing the incident edge changes the recommendation. Existing Ghost findings, audits and repairs remain separate. The guide records the schema, local setup and exact boundary between new event work and reused Ghost foundations.

title: A reproducible Graph Hacks submission demo
description: Added a disposable FalkorDB walkthrough that changes one incident edge and verifies F-002 → F-003 → F-002, plus regression checks, CI replay, a captioned video and a submission brief. Recorded the new-versus-reused boundary and pending eligibility checks explicitly: the live event rules remain blocked by the environment network policy, so registration, build-window compliance and submission are not claimed.

title: Explain changing SQLite sidecars without weakening storage checks
description: Added a distinct recovery message for repeated safe sidecar replacement and bounded diagnostic notes for storage guards. Deterministic races cover retries, unsafe replacements, real SQLite sidecar removal and descriptor cleanup. A concurrent stress run completed 3,600 writes and 3,600 reads; the earlier cancellation failure remains unexplained. Recorded a ten-minute development checkpoint procedure; no unattended agent scheduler is installed.

title: One command to record the FalkorDB demo
description: Added ghost demo --graph with live ranking, incident-link removal and restoration in a temporary graph. Interactive Enter-key pauses support recording; JSON and no-pause modes support automation. The installed command works outside the checkout, preserves existing demo modes and graphs, and cleans up on interruption or partial-load failure.

title: Record the graph demo without Docker
description: Added an optional FalkorDBLite runtime for ghost demo --graph --embedded. Ghost owns a native database process on a private Unix socket, executes the same live ranking and evidence queries, and stops the process and removes temporary data on success or interruption. The default server flow remains available; native platform requirements and dependency licenses are documented.
